heading: One App, Many Users

items.title: Profile
items.text: Each user can create their own profile complete with current health metrics like height, weight, and health inputs.

items.title: Subscription
items.text: The app can be configured as a free service with limited functionalities or as a paid one with subscription.

items.title: Activity timeline
items.text: Users can view their activity routine from day one until the present day through a well-designed dashboard.

items.title: Daily plan
items.text: A customized daily plan to help users to train for their goals using weights, cardio, strength training, etc.

items.title: Daily activity inputs
items.text: Users can input the app with relevant information about daily activities which will be used to create the activity timeline.

items.title: Video training
items.text: The app will have videos from experts to help them train the right manner without suffering any injuries due to mistakes.

items.title: Live chat
items.text: A live chat feature will be available in the app to enable users to chat with their fitness instructors for improving results.

items.title: Diet chart
items.text: Weight loss, weight gain, fitness training — the app can give a customized diet chart customized to each fitness goal

items.title: Fitness plans
items.text: Daily, weekly, monthly and quarterly fitness plans will be charted to help the user progress consistently.

items.title: Workout plans
items.text: According to fitnes goals, the personal trainer provides exclusive custom workout routines to the premium customers.

items.title: Track Progress
items.text: Users can monitor their progress in terms of calories burnt, fitness performance, endurance, etc

items.title: Steps counter
items.text: In-built navigation and motion sensors will ensure that every step taken by the user during a day is counted by steps counter.

items.title: Calorie counter
items.text: Users can input the food items that are consuming daily to keep track of their calorie intake.

items.title: Alerts and reminders
items.text: Built-in alert and reminder system that notifies when it is time for daily workout.

items.title: Customer support
items.text: Round the clock, multi-channel support to attend to any troubleshooting issues with the app.

items.title: Payment options
items.text: In-app purchases and multiple payment options to enable users to pay in the medium that suits them the most.

items.title: FAQ
items.text: A detailed FAQ section where every possible query is addressed in a detailed manner.

items.title: Blogs
items.text: A branded blog complete with facility to publish text, image and video blogs.

items.title: Recipes
items.text: Explore and find recipes for weight gain, reduction or improving endurance.

items.title: Rating and Reviews
items.text: Users can review and rate each personal trainer based on their training experience and results achieved.

items.title: Profile
items.text: Each personal trainer can create their own profile enlisting their experience, qualifications and certifications.

items.title: Upload Workout Videos
items.text: Personal trainers can upload their own workout videos that can help users train themselves.

items.title: Send Reminders
items.text: Facility to send timely reminders to users who have subscribed to personal trainer services.

items.title: Schedule Consultation
items.text: Trainers can approve/reject personal consultation requests made by users.

items.title: Manage Workout Plans
items.text: Trainers can organize and manage all workout plans they have suggested to users.

items.title: Track Pre-Workout Details
items.text: Users can be instructed to prep the right way before the intense workout session begins

items.title: Fitness Chart
items.text: Trainers can see the progress of users in a fitness chart that is designed like a comprehensive dashboard.

items.title: Rating and Reviews
items.text: Personal trainer can rate and review its trainee as per its dedication and other fitness parameters.

items.title: Message the users
items.text: Trainers can message to communicate with users to check ongoing workout sessions, future plans and goals to be achieved.

items.title: Profile
items.text: Each dietitian can create a personalized profile complete with information about their educational background, working experience and expertise.

items.title: Customized Nutrition Plan
items.text: Dietitian can easily create a customized nutrition plan for each user with the help of a simplified UI for picking and adding diet items.

items.title: Subscription Packages
items.text: Dietitians can set their own subscription packages based on their level of experience, expertise and services offered.

items.title: BMI Calculator
items.text: A built-in BMI calculator that allows dietitian to quickly calculate the BMI

items.title: Fitness Chart
items.text: Dietitians can create customized fitness charts for each users aligned to their fitness goals and diet practices.

items.title: Rating and Reviews
items.text: Dietitian can rate and review its client as per its observation and fitness progress.

items.title: Message the users
items.text: Users and dietitians can text each other to exchange diet charts, frequency of mails, supplements if any, to be taken.

items.title: Dashboard
items.text: Admins can have control the app’s functioning, users/dietitians/trainers being added to the app from the dashboard.

items.title: User management
items.text: Adding new users, deleting dormant accounts, controlling user privileges — users can do much more with their user management controls.

items.title: Manage Subscription plans
items.text: Add new subscription plans or edit existing ones to reflect the right pricing plan on the app.

items.title: Manage trainer
items.text: Admins can add new trainers to the app, check their background and also maintain trainer records in the backend.

items.title: Manage food plans
items.text: Admins can create custom food plans on their own and position them in the app for maximum visibility.

items.title: Manage Nutrition
items.text: Create goal-based nutrition plans to help users achieve their fitness goals. Admin can assort and arrange nutrition plans for paid and free members.

items.title: Diet list
items.text: Create and upload a detailed diet list for dishes to be made with specific types of ingredients, recipes, time of the day, etc.

items.title: Diet template
items.text: Make it easy for users to follow a diet chart with diet templates that list down food intake, calorie count all in one place.

items.title: Workout creation
items.text: Create diverse kinds of workouts like weight training, strength training, athletics, endurance, yoga, etc.

items.title: Exercise management
items.text: Manage exercises to be carried out and personal goals to be achieved from a dashboard.

items.title: Calorie counter
items.text: Measure calorie intake on a regular basis by giving input of food consumed.

items.title: Workout videos
items.text: Learn the right way of working out with videos from expert fitness trainers.

items.title: Blog post
items.text: A dedicated module to manage blogs published in the app’s name.

items.title: Diet recipes
items.text: Super admin creates entire diet recipes for all the dietitian. Further dietitians this diet recipes according to users plans.

items.title: Manage bots
items.text: The app can be integrated with bots that can engage in live chat with users.

items.title: Notification management
items.text: Admins set the custom notifications system for the users daily meals, workout plans and fitness goals.

text2: We design and develop health & fitness mobile apps that users, personal trainers, dietitians and admins can use alike.
